name: NSW Inc.
summary: NSW Inc. operates as an enterprise, services, embedded, and device solutions provider in Japan. It provides business solutions, such as consulting, system design, development, maintenance, and operation solutions for manufacturing, distribution, finance, insurance, and government sectors. The company also offers IT services, including servers and network designing; secure environment development; and operating and monitoring systems, as well as IoT & AI services. In addition, it is involved in the embedded system development business, which include development of applications, middleware, and drivers for automotive and industrial sectors; and edge device solutions.
